spans.s:
√bhūṣ 'attend upon, adorn'
present: [1.] bhū́ṣati etc. 
[perfect: bubhūṣa abubhūṣat abhūṣīt bhūṣiṣyati bhūṣitā ]
secondary: causative: bhūṣayati etc. E.+ bhūṣayate etc. E.+ 
derivatives: bhūṣā E.+ bhūṣya C. bhūṣaṇa E.+ -bhūṣéṇya RV. bhūṣitavya JB. bhūṣayitavya E.+ 
A secondary root-form, from √bhū. The Vedic forms are divided by BR. between two roots: 1bhūṣ, 'be, move' etc., 2bhūṣ, 'attend upon' etc.
